description: Preset-based synthesizer with Subtractive, Wavetable, Multisample, FM & AM synthesis engines. Over 50GB of content across multiple expansion packs.

interface_sections.bottom: Master FX Chain (Filter, Delay, Reverb, Limiter)

parameters.name: Macros 1-8
parameters.description: Custom meta-controls specific to each preset. One macro often controls 10+ underlying parameters simultaneously.
tips: Automate these to transform the sound completely
Lock macros (show panel locks) to keep settings when browsing presets
These are the most powerful controls in FLEX
automation_ideas: Slow automation (4-8 bars) for evolving textures
Fast automation (1/16 notes) for wobble bass

parameters.name: Cutoff
parameters.label: Filter Cutoff
parameters.description: Controls the brightness by filtering frequencies above (Low Pass) or below (High Pass) the cutoff point.
parameters.parameter_interaction: Affected by Env Amt (envelope modulation) and often linked to Macro 1
tips: Higher for brighter, more aggressive sounds
Works in conjunction with Master Filter
automation_ideas: Slow upward sweep for filter builds

parameters.name: Resonance
parameters.label: Filter Resonance / Q
parameters.description: Boosts frequencies around the cutoff point, creating emphasis and 'squelch'.
parameters.parameter_interaction: Works with Cutoff - high resonance with low cutoff = bass emphasis
tips: Can cause self-oscillation at very high values
parameters.warning: Very high resonance can create loud, piercing frequencies - monitor levels

parameters.name: Env Amt
parameters.label: Envelope Amount
parameters.description: Controls how much the envelope modulates the filter cutoff.
parameters.parameter_interaction: Uses the same envelope as volume (AHDSR)
tips: Positive values: Filter opens from low to high (wah effect)
Negative values: Filter closes from high to low (ow effect)
Combine with resonance for pronounced effects

parameters.name: Attack (A)
parameters.label: Envelope Attack
parameters.description: Time from 0% to 100% volume/brightness after key press.
parameters.parameter_interaction: Affects both volume and filter cutoff (if Env Amt is set)
tips: Add 2-5% if you hear clicks at note start

parameters.name: Hold (H)
parameters.label: Envelope Hold
parameters.description: Time at peak level before decay starts.
tips: Medium hold (20-40%) for percussive elements with body
Long hold (50%+) for organ-like sustained attack

parameters.name: Decay (D)
parameters.label: Envelope Decay
parameters.description: Time from peak level down to sustain level.

parameters.name: Sustain (S)
parameters.label: Envelope Sustain
parameters.description: Volume level maintained while key is held (after decay phase).
parameters.parameter_interaction: This is a LEVEL, not a time. 100% = full volume, 0% = silent
tips: Lower sustain if sound is too loud when held

parameters.name: Release (R)
parameters.label: Envelope Release
parameters.description: Time from current level to 0% after key release.
tips: Short release (5-15%) for tight, punchy sounds (808s)
Reduce release if notes overlap and muddy the mix
parameters.warning: Very long releases can cause CPU buildup with complex chords

parameters.name: Master Filter Type
parameters.label: Master Filter Type Selector
parameters.description: Global filter applied to the final output. Different algorithms for mixing and creative effects.
tips: Use High Pass 12dB @ 150-200Hz for de-mudding non-bass sounds

parameters.name: Master Filter Cutoff
parameters.label: Master Filter Frequency
parameters.description: Sets the frequency point for the Master Filter.
tips: Critical parameter for build-ups and drops

parameters.name: Master Filter Resonance
parameters.label: Master Filter Q/Resonance
parameters.description: Resonance/emphasis for the Master Filter.
tips: Keep at 0% for clean mixing filters

parameters.name: Delay Type
parameters.label: Delay Mode Selector
parameters.description: Delay algorithm type affecting stereo behavior.

option_details.Fake Stereo: Haas effect - very short L/R offset for widening
option_details.True Stereo: Independent L/R delays - preserves stereo image
option_details.Ping Pong: Bounces between left and right channels

tips: Fake Stereo for widening mono sounds (10-25ms)
True Stereo for maintaining stereo presets
Ping Pong for rhythmic, spatial effects

parameters.name: Delay Time
parameters.label: Delay Time/Sync
parameters.description: Time between delay repeats. Can be free-running or tempo-synced.
tips: Use free time (ms) for slapback and Haas effects
Dotted times (1/4 Dot, 1/8 Dot) sound more musical

parameters.name: Delay Feedback
parameters.label: Delay Feedback/Repeats
parameters.description: Amount of delay output fed back into input - controls number of echoes.
parameters.warning: Feedback above 85% can create runaway feedback - automate carefully
automation_ideas: Automate 30% to 80% during builds for dub effects

parameters.name: Delay Mix
parameters.label: Delay Wet/Dry Mix
parameters.description: Balance between dry (unprocessed) and wet (delayed) signal.
tips: Use lower values for mixing, higher for effects

parameters.name: Reverb Decay
parameters.label: Reverb Decay Time
parameters.description: Time for reverb tail to fade to silence.
tips: Faster tempos need shorter decay to avoid mud

parameters.name: Reverb Size
parameters.label: Reverb Room Size
parameters.description: Simulated room/space size.

parameters.name: Reverb Mix
parameters.label: Reverb Wet/Dry Mix
parameters.description: Balance between dry and reverb signal.
common_mistakes: Too much reverb muddies the mix
Using reverb on bass destroys low-end clarity
Same reverb amount on all presets - be dynamic

parameters.name: Reverb Color
parameters.label: Reverb Tone/Brightness
parameters.description: Tone/brightness of the reverb tail.
tips: Match color to genre - dark for lo-fi, bright for EDM

parameters.name: Reverb Mod
parameters.label: Reverb Modulation
parameters.description: Adds pitch modulation/chorus to reverb tail.
tips: Use to add movement to static pads

parameters.name: Limiter Type
parameters.label: Limiter Mode
parameters.description: Limiting/compression algorithm with different saturation colors.
tips: Warming for analog warmth and glue

parameters.name: Limiter Pre
parameters.label: Limiter Pre-Gain
parameters.description: Input gain into the limiter section. Drives saturation/distortion.
parameters.warning: High Pre gain can cause clipping - reduce mixer level if needed

parameters.name: Master Volume
parameters.label: Output Level
parameters.description: Final output level before FL Studio mixer.
tips: Lock this (padlock icon) to maintain consistent volume when browsing presets
Reduce if preset is too loud

parameters.name: Pitch
parameters.label: Fine Tune
parameters.description: Fine pitch tuning in cents (100 cents = 1 semitone).
tips: ±10-15 cents for slight detuning between layers
Use for matching presets to out-of-tune samples

parameters.name: Arpeggiator Icon
parameters.label: Arpeggiator Toggle
parameters.description: Enables/disables built-in arpeggiator or sequencer for preset.
tips: If preset has unwanted rhythm, turn this off

parameters.name: Dump Score Icon
parameters.label: Extract MIDI
parameters.description: Extracts MIDI notes from loop-based presets to Piano Roll.
tips: Only available on presets with embedded MIDI
Click to dump notes to active pattern
Use for learning, variation, or layering

common_problems.solution: Click the 'Arpeggiator' icon (pyramid of dots) in the pitch section to disable the built-in arp.
common_problems.visual_indicator: Icon changes from Orange (on) to Grey (off)

common_problems.symptom: Sound never stops playing / Long tail
common_problems.solution: Reduce the 'R' (Release) slider in the Volume Envelope section to 5-15%.
additional_checks: Check Reverb Mix - high reverb can extend tails
Check Delay Feedback - high feedback creates infinite echoes

common_problems.solution: Increase the 'Master Volume' slider (bottom right) or 'Limiter Pre' gain (10-30%).
alternative_solutions: Check if Macros are turned down
Check if preset has very low sustain level

common_problems.solution: Reduce Master Volume or Limiter Pre gain. Check for red clipping indicators.
common_problems.prevention: Lock Master Volume at comfortable level when browsing presets

common_problems.symptom: Sound is too wet / washed out / drowning in reverb
common_problems.solution: Lower Reverb Mix to 0-20% and Delay Mix to 0-20%. Check Macros 5-8 which often control effects.
common_problems.additional_tip: Lock these knobs if you want to browse with consistent wetness

common_problems.symptom: Sound is too bright / harsh / piercing
common_problems.solution: Lower Filter Cutoff, or enable Master Filter 'Low Pass 12dB' at 8-10kHz. Check Macro 1 (often brightness).
additional_solutions: Reduce Filter Resonance if set high
Use Limiter 'Warming' instead of 'Limiter' for softer highs

common_problems.symptom: Sound is too dark / muffled / dull
common_problems.solution: Increase Filter Cutoff to 70-90%, or check if Master Filter Low Pass is enabled (disable it).
additional_checks: Ensure Env Amt isn't set to negative with fast attack

common_problems.symptom: Click or pop at note start
common_problems.solution: Increase Attack slider slightly (2-5%) to soften the transient.
alternative_causes: Limiter Pre too high causing clipping

common_problems.symptom: Bass sounds too wide / loses power in mono
common_problems.solution: Check Vectorscope - should be vertical line. Lower 'Width' or 'Unison' Macros. Use mixer stereo separation at 0% for bass.
common_problems.prevention: Always check bass sounds in mono
common_problems.critical: Wide bass causes phase cancellation on club systems

common_problems.symptom: CPU usage too high / Audio glitches
common_problems.solution: Check for 'Unison' or 'Voices' Macros and reduce them. Increase FL Studio buffer size. Freeze/render track.
additional_solutions: Render to audio if performance critical

common_problems.solution: Reduce Release time to 10-20%. For bass, keep at 5-10%.
additional_checks: Use High Pass filter on non-bass elements

common_problems.solution: Some parameters were locked. Click FLEX logo → uncheck 'Show panel locks' or unlock individual padlock icons.
common_problems.note: This is actually a feature - use locks intentionally to maintain settings

common_problems.solution: The 'Dump Score' icon is grey, meaning this preset has no embedded MIDI data. Only loop-based presets support MIDI extraction.
common_problems.workaround: Record the audio and use melody detection, or play it manually

common_problems.solution: Check Env Amt knob - if set high (positive or negative), it's modulating the filter. Set to 0% for static filter.
additional_checks: Check if Macro is controlling filter cutoff
Look for automation on Filter Cutoff

common_problems.symptom: Sound cuts off before MIDI note ends
common_problems.solution: Increase Sustain level to 80-100%, or check if Decay is too short with 0% Sustain (causes one-shot behavior).
common_problems.note: Some presets intentionally use 0% Sustain for pluck/percussion sounds

workflow_best_practices: Lock Master Volume when browsing presets to maintain consistent loudness
Always check bass sounds with Vectorscope - should be mono (vertical line)
Use Alt + Click on Macros to reset to designer's intended default
Automate Macros for movement - static presets sound boring
Check mono compatibility before exporting - especially on bass
Use 'Show panel locks' feature to keep reverb/volume consistent while browsing
Start with Limiter 'Limiter' mode, only add color if needed
High Pass filter everything except kick and bass
Use short Attack times for rhythmic elements, long for pads

keyboard_shortcuts.shortcut: Double-Click FLEX logo or Analysis display

cpu_optimization: Increase buffer size in FL Studio settings
